result.instructions: Tools for MoonClerk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which MoonClerk plans are past due right now?"; "List the payments that failed this month."; "Which subscriptions are due to bill next week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MoonClerk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run moonclerk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run moonclerk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run moonclerk_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. moonclerk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: moonclerk_list_forms
tools.title: List payment forms
tools.description: List the MoonClerk payment forms: id, title, currency, payment_volume (cents), successful_checkout_count and created/updated times. Use the form ids to filter customers (plans) and payments. Read-only. GET /forms.

offset.description: Start position (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset to get the next page.

tools.name: moonclerk_get_form
tools.title: Get payment form
tools.description: One payment form by id: title, currency, payment volume and checkout count. Read-only. GET /forms/{id}.

tools.name: moonclerk_list_customers
tools.title: List customers (plans)
tools.description: List MoonClerk customers, which the MoonClerk web app calls "Plans": each is one payer with their subscription (status, plan amount and interval, next payment date, trial and cancel dates), payment method (brand, last 4), coupon discount, custom form fields and the form they used. Filter by form, status (active, canceled, expired, past_due, pending, unpaid), sign-up date range or next-payment date range, e.g. past_due plans or renewals due this month. The payer's management link and checkout token are never returned. Read-only. GET /customers.

form_id.description: Only customers who signed up through this form.

checkout_from.description: Customers created on or after this date.

checkout_to.description: Customers created on or before this date.

next_payment_from.description: Subscriptions due to bill on or after this date.

next_payment_to.description: Subscriptions due to bill on or before this date.

offset.description: Start position (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset to get the next page.

tools.name: moonclerk_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer (plan)
tools.description: One MoonClerk customer (plan) by id with the full subscription, payment method, discount, checkout amounts (subtotal, fee, total, upfront amount, trial days) and custom field answers. The payer's management link and checkout token are never returned. Read-only. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: moonclerk_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List MoonClerk payments (charges): date, status (successful, refunded, failed), amount, Stripe fee and amount refunded in cents, currency, payer name and email, payment method, form, customer id (recurring payments only), coupon and custom fields. Filter by form, customer, status or charge-date range, e.g. failed payments this month or refunds for one plan. Amounts are in cents. Read-only. GET /payments.

form_id.description: Only payments made through this form.

date_from.description: Payments charged on or after this date.

date_to.description: Payments charged on or before this date.

offset.description: Start position (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset to get the next page.

tools.name: moonclerk_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: One MoonClerk payment by id with amounts (cents), Stripe fee, refunds, payer, payment method, Stripe references (charge, customer, invoice), coupon, custom fields and one-time checkout data. The checkout token is never returned. Read-only. GET /payments/{id}.
